profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website presents Claude as its AI, described as built for problem solvers and aimed at complex challenges, data analysis, writing code, and hard thinking work.

The company's tracked products center on Claude, listed as a general LLM assistant, alongside Anthropic Console, an API management console with prompt testing, evaluation tools, usage monitoring, and cost controls, and Claude Code, described as agentic coding. A fourth product, Computer Use, is listed as a computer control agent for desktop automation and system access, with high-privilege operation risk noted. A separate MCP server entry, LLM Orchestration Agent (Langchain Anthropic), is also associated with the company.

Anthropic appears in a set of court cases. These include appeals before the Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit and the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, and district court matters in the District of Vermont, the District of Hawaii, the District of Delaware, the Northern District of California, and the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. Named cases include Brandon Grossinger v. Anthropic PBC, Cowan DeBaets Abrahams & Sheppard, LLP, et al. v. Anthropic, PBC, Edelson, PC, et al. v. Anthropic, PBC, Brunell v. Anthropic PBC, Gribble v. Anthropic PBC, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, Patel v. Anthropic, PBC, Smith v. Anthropic, PBC, Pascual v. Anthropic, PBC, University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC, and GROSSINGER v. ANTHROPIC, PBC. A legal exposure tally by state lists California with a count of 281.
